Ethereum ETFs Lose $320 Million In A Week As Bitcoin Outflows Slow

US spot Ethereum ETFs lost $320.1 million in the week ending October 16, more than the $228.4 million withdrawn from Bitcoin funds. BlackRock’s ETHA accounted for nearly all of the Ether redemptions.

Ethereum investment funds have ended another difficult week on the wrong side of the ledger. US spot Ether ETFs recorded $320.1 million in net withdrawals between October 12 and 16, while comparable Bitcoin products lost $228.4 million, according to Farside Investors.

The difference is striking, but it needs some context. Ether funds were not suffering their worst week on record. They lost roughly $542 million in the preceding five sessions. What changed most visibly this week was the pace of Bitcoin redemptions, which slowed enough to put Ethereum ahead in the outflow rankings.

BlackRock’s iShares Ethereum Trust, ETHA, did most of the damage. Its five-day net loss was approximately $299 million, almost 93% of the total across US spot Ether funds. Monday started with an $85.4 million industry-wide withdrawal; a $24.8 million inflow on Tuesday offered a brief reprieve, before selling returned on Wednesday, Thursday and Friday.

Fidelity’s FETH managed modest positive flows during the week, underlining that investors were not treating every issuer alike.

ETF flow figures reflect creations and redemptions of fund shares, not a direct measure of all demand for ETH. Still, the concentration of withdrawals in the market’s largest Ether product raises an uncomfortable question: if institutional appetite returns, will it return to Ethereum as quickly as it does to Bitcoin?

Nasdaq plunges while ETH rebounds over the weekend | Funding risks remain unresolved | I’m waiting for a confirmed breakout

My stance is to be cautious about the rebound and not interpret the weekend rally as the start of a new trend. Binance Square is discussing last week’s sharp drop in the Nasdaq 100. A weekend article published by the Nasdaq Economic Research Institute on October 16 said the index fell about 5% over the week, which is not exactly the same as the 5.5% figure used in the trending topic on Binance Square. I’m using the official “about 5%” figure rather than treating the trending-topic number as an exact closing figure. Meanwhile, Farside’s fund-by-fund data shows that U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs saw net outflows of $69.7 million on October 16, mainly from ETHA. ETF net flows track creations and redemptions; they do not mean that $69.7 million of spot ETH was sold on exchanges at the same time, nor do they justify saying institutions have fully withdrawn.

Taken together, these facts affect ETH not through any single bearish catalyst, but through tighter risk budgets: when tech stocks pull back, multi-asset accounts typically reduce their more volatile exposure first; continued ETF outflows also make visible spot demand less certain. ETH’s longer-term narrative—staking, on-chain activity, and upgrade expectations—doesn’t disappear because of a one-day flow report, but short-term pricing is still constrained by dollar liquidity and appetite for leverage. With U.S. stock markets closed over the weekend, ETH can rebound first. But if the weekend price action is mistakenly taken as proof that ETH has permanently decoupled from U.S. equities, it could be vulnerable to a reversal when risk assets reopen on Monday.

The market has already provided half the answer: as I write, ETH/USD is around $2,419 on Kraken, above the day’s open of about $2,400; the rolling 24-hour low is around $2,354 and the high around $2,433. In other words, buyers did show up at the lows, but the price has not yet convincingly cleared the 24-hour high. For now, I’m watching whether ETH can break above $2,433 and hold it on a retest. Below that, I’m watching the intraday low near $2,395 first, then $2,354. If the price holds above resistance, $2,470 and $2,510 are areas to monitor in stages, not guaranteed targets. The conditions that would invalidate my view are clear: a quick drop back below $2,395 after the breakout, or the Nasdaq continuing to weaken on the next U.S. trading day while ETH also loses $2,354. In that case, the “independent rebound” would amount to no more than a brief recovery.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase a long or open a short right now. My tentative bias is to wait for confirmation before trying a spot long, with an initial position no larger than 3% of total capital and no leverage. I’d only consider entering in stages if ETH closes an hourly candle above $2,433 and then holds that level on a retest. If the price has already moved far beyond the trigger when it breaks out, I’d pass rather than chase with a market order. I’d take half off at $2,470, reduce most of the remainder near $2,510, and close any leftover position if the price falls back below $2,433. I’d set a hard stop below $2,395 after entry, accounting for actual execution and slippage. If ETH breaks below $2,395 first, I’d stay flat and reassess only if a base forms around $2,354; I wouldn’t average down during a decline. This is a conditional plan, not a record of trades already made, nor a promise about Monday’s price action.

Sources: Nasdaq Economic Research Institute weekend market article dated October 16; Farside’s fund-by-fund U.S. Ethereum ETF flow data; Kraken ETH/USD market data at the time of writing. #Nasdaq100Falls5.5%InWorstWeekIn18Months #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

纳指重挫而ETH周末回升｜资金风险仍未解除｜我只等突破确认

我的态度是谨慎看反弹，不把周末上涨直接翻译成新一轮趋势。币安广场正在讨论纳指100上周急跌；纳斯达克经济研究院10月16日的周末文章写的是该指数一周约跌5%，与广场热题所用的5.5%口径并不完全相同，我采用官方“约5%”而不把热题数字当精确收盘值。同时，Farside逐只汇总显示，美国现货以太坊ETF在10月16日净流出6970万美元，主要来自ETHA。ETF净流是申购赎回统计，不等于交易所现货在同一时刻卖出6970万美元，更不能据此说机构已经全面撤离。

这两个事实放在一起，影响ETH的机制不是某条单独利空，而是风险预算收缩：科技股回撤时，多资产账户通常先降低波动较大的敞口；ETF持续流出则削弱现货承接的可见度。ETH又有质押、链上活跃和升级预期，长期叙事不因一个交易日资金表消失，但短线定价仍受美元流动性和杠杆偏好的约束。周末美股休市，ETH可以先反弹；若把周末价格独立运行误判为与美股永久脱钩，周一风险资产重新开盘时容易吃到回摆。

市场已经给出一半答案：我写稿时Kraken的ETH/USD约2419美元，高于当日开盘约2400美元；滚动24小时低点约2354、高点约2433。也就是说低位确有买盘，但价格尚未有效越过近24小时上沿。眼前我看2433能否突破并回踩守住，下面先看2395附近的日内低位，再看2354。上方若站稳，2470和2510只是分批观察区，不是保证会到的目标。判断被推翻的条件很明确：突破后很快跌回2395以下，或者下一个美股交易日纳指继续走弱、ETH同步失守2354；届时“独立反弹”只能算短暂修复。

如果是我自己交易，当前不追多、不做空，方向暂定等待确认后的现货试多，初始仓位最多总资金3%，不用杠杆。只有ETH在2433上方完成一小时收盘，随后回踩仍守住2433，我才考虑分批入场；若突破时已经远离触发位，就放弃，不用市价追。到2470先减一半，2510附近再减剩余的大部分，余仓若跌回2433即平仓；入场后硬止损设在2395下方，按实际成交和滑点执行。若先跌破2395，我保持空仓，等待2354附近重新形成止跌结构再评估，不在下跌途中摊低成本。这是条件计划，不是已成交记录，也不是对周一行情的承诺。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Rule: Why Being Able to Afford Losses Helps You Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule everyone has heard a million times but 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should be no more than 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 USDT in starting capital, 2% means you can lose at most 200 USDT on a single trade. After 10 losses in a row, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down just 20%, a few winning trades can get you back. On the other hand, if you go all-in each time and lose 30%,
After three losses in a row, you’re left with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly triple it to break even—a mathematical death sentence.

【How to apply it】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%”; it’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
is no more than 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the distance to the stop → work backward to determine your position size.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Staged profit-taking: How to lock in gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the staged profit-taking approach I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: When the price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell a third to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade is already risk-free, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage two: When the price reaches the second target,
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another third. Stage three: Let a trailing stop manage the rest. Exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you exit your entire position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, your gains often disappear before your eyes.

zkAPI privacy payments are drawing attention｜They are not the same as Monero transaction privacy｜With XMR near $584, I’m waiting

My view is that privacy needs deserve serious attention, but I wouldn’t chase XMR today based on a cross-project privacy story. Binance News reported that Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin demonstrated a “paranoid mode” for AI agents involving Tor and privacy payments. What can be verified from primary sources is narrower: Vitalik’s publicly available zkAPI code repository explains that users can pay for AI or other APIs with ETH, using zero-knowledge proofs to let service providers verify their ability to pay while reducing the link between API requests and on-chain deposit addresses. The repository explicitly says the protocol is still experimental. This shows that developers are addressing the links between network requests, payment records, and identity. But it does not mean Monero has been integrated with the tool, that ETH privacy payments are mature and widely adopted, or that XMR is therefore attracting institutional buying.

Why am I still paying attention? Because crypto discussions often lump different layers together under the word “privacy.” zkAPI deals with the link between payments and calls in specific applications; Tor deals with network routing; prompt rewriting deals with the content of inputs. Monero’s website, by contrast, describes its core feature as hiding the sender, recipient, and amount of on-chain transfers by default. These technologies may address the same user concerns, but they are not the same product and do not share revenue. Experiments in AI-agent privacy could help more people understand the risks of metadata leaks and increase long-term interest in privacy technology. But for that to translate into incremental demand for XMR, we would need to see sustained improvements in wallet usage, real transaction activity, exchange availability, and liquidity. Predicting that XMR will “benefit” based on a single news item alone is too tenuous a causal leap.

The market action should be assessed separately. At the time of writing, XMR/USD on Kraken was around $583.68, above the daily open of $569.93, with a wide rolling 24-hour range of $544.51 to $607.87. I can’t prove that this rise was driven by zkAPI or the AI news. The area around $580 is a zone to watch for short-term support, while around $608 is resistance at the recent high. If the price repeatedly fails to break through $608 and falls back below $570, I’d see the rally as lacking staying power. If the 24-hour low near $545 is decisively broken, the bullish outlook described above is invalidated. Conversely, only a high-volume break above $608 followed by a successful retest would count as confirmation—not simply seeing a long green candle and guessing that another one is coming.

If I were trading this myself, my current XMR position would be 0%. The only direction I’d consider is a leveraged-free spot long; I wouldn’t chase a privacy-theme rally driven by sentiment. My entry conditions would be two consecutive complete 15-minute candles closing above $608, followed by a pullback that stabilizes in the $602–$608 range. I’d allocate no more than 1.5% of my total capital to the position. My first target would be $620, where I’d sell half; my second target would be $636, where I’d close the rest. After entry, if a 15-minute candle closes back below $598, I’d reduce the position by half; if a 1-hour candle closes below $590, I’d exit completely. If the price breaks below $570 before I enter, I’d cancel this long setup. These price levels are for discipline, not a promise of returns; if the conditions aren’t met, there’s no trade, and I won’t present a watchlist idea as a profit.

为什么我仍然关注？因为加密市场谈“隐私”常常把不同层面混成一个词。zkAPI处理的是特定应用的支付与调用关联，Tor处理网络路径，提示词改写处理输入内容；Monero官网描述的核心则是链上转账默认隐藏发送方、接收方和金额。它们可能回应同一种用户顾虑，却不是同一个产品，也不共享收入。AI代理隐私实验若让更多人理解元数据泄露风险，可能提高对隐私技术的长期讨论度；要形成XMR可交易的增量需求，还需要看到钱包使用、真实交易活动、交易所可得性和流动性持续改善。只凭一条新闻就预言XMR“受益”，因果链条不够。

如果是我自己交易，当前XMR仓位0%，方向只考虑无杠杆现货试多，不做隐私题材的情绪追涨。触发条件是两个完整15分钟K线收在608上方、随后回踩602—608企稳，最多拿总资金1.5%入场。目标一620，届时减半；目标二636，余仓全部平仓。入场后15分钟收回598下方先减半，1小时收盘跌破590止损清仓；若未入场就先跌破570，取消本轮多头计划。这个价位只是执行纪律，不是收益承诺；未触发就是没有成交，更不会把观察写成盈利。

Crypto Market: What to Watch Right Now

Assessing the market based on the rise of a single coin is risky. A more reliable picture emerges from several signals: the performance of BTC and ETH, the breadth of altcoin moves, trading volume, and price reactions at key levels.

If most liquid pairs are falling, a strong rally in one asset does not yet mean a full reversal. If the decline slows, the number of rising pairs gradually increases, and the price holds support on steady volume, this may indicate stabilization. But confirmation requires repeated observations—a single green candlestick impulse is not enough.

What to watch:
• BTC and ETH — market direction and their ability to hold local levels.
• Market breadth — how many pairs are rising and how many continue to fall.
• Volume — whether it confirms the move or the impulse quickly fades.
• Volatility and liquidity — sharp moves may be accompanied by false breakouts.
• Risk management — a predefined level for invalidating a scenario is more important than trying to guess the bottom.

Bottom line: don’t confuse a short-term bounce with a confirmed reversal. It’s better to wait for several signals that align and assess the market using fresh data, not emotions or sensational headlines.

Крипторынок: что важно отслеживать сейчас

Оценивать рынок только по росту одной монеты опасно. Более надёжная картина складывается из нескольких сигналов: динамики BTC и ETH, ширины движения альткоинов, торгового оборота и реакции цены на ключевые уровни.

Если большинство ликвидных пар снижается, отдельный сильный рост ещё не означает полноценного разворота. Если падение замедляется, число растущих пар постепенно увеличивается, а цена удерживает поддержку при устойчивом объёме, это может говорить о стабилизации. Но подтверждение требует повторных наблюдений — одного зелёного свечного импульса недостаточно.

На что смотреть:
• BTC и ETH — направление рынка и способность удерживать локальные уровни.
• Ширина рынка — сколько пар растёт и сколько продолжает снижаться.
• Объём — подтверждает ли он движение или импульс быстро затухает.
• Волатильность и ликвидность — резкие движения могут сопровождаться ложными пробоями.
• Управление риском — заранее определённый уровень отмены сценария важнее попытки угадать дно.

Вывод: не стоит путать краткосрочный отскок с подтверждённым разворотом. Лучше дождаться нескольких согласованных сигналов и оценивать рынок по свежим данным, а не по эмоциям и громким заголовкам.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where exactly should you place a stop-loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop matters more than whether you use one. Place it too close and it gets hit all the time; too far away and one loss can really hurt.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop may end up right where other traders’ stops are clustered.

ETH test upgrade includes cross-chain factory｜Already on mainnet doesn’t mean a new catalyst｜Consider only after holding above 2438

My stance is to watch, not to buy into every name on an upgrade list. The Ethereum Foundation’s October 16 Glamsterdam announcement included EIP-7997, “Deterministic Factory Contracts,” among the items planned for testing on Hoodi. Hoodi activation is scheduled for October 26 at 17:42:48 UTC, while the mainnet activation date has not yet been decided. The EIP is in the Last Call stage. Its goal is to make a widely used CREATE2 factory address and its code a requirement shared by EVM chains, making it easier for developers to deploy at the same address across multiple chains. The key caveat: the proposal itself states that Ethereum mainnet and many other chains already have this factory; for chains that meet the requirement, adopting it is essentially a “no-op.” This is not a new contract appearing out of nowhere today, nor does it automatically make wallet balances interoperable across chains or guarantee asset security.

Why is it still worth watching? Multichain applications and smart contract wallets often incur higher frontend, signing and authorization, and verification costs because their deployment addresses differ across chains. A unified deterministic factory can reduce one kind of configuration error, indirectly improving development and user experience. But having the same address only means deployment is predictable. It does not mean liquidity is shared across chains, the code has been audited, cross-chain bridges are risk-free, or ETH demand will be created directly. The EIP’s security section also warns that if a contract being deployed reads the transaction environment, front-running deployment could let an attacker choose its parameters. So I care more about testnet compatibility, developer tooling adoption, and audit feedback than using the word “cross-chain” to speculate on an immediate token price move.

How has the market reacted so far? Kraken’s ETH/USD was around $2,421.59 just now, with a rolling 24-hour range of $2,354.01–$2,438, showing strength relative to the $2,399.83 reference opening price for the day. This rebound is worth watching, but there is no evidence that it was driven solely by the EIP list released two days ago. U.S. stock markets are closed for the weekend, and there is no new regular ETF trading-day data on creations and redemptions; Friday’s old flows should not be presented as institutions continuing to buy right now. The rolling high of $2,438 is the level to watch above; if ETH holds firmly above it, then $2,465 comes into view. Below, watch $2,400 first, then $2,354. If ETH repeatedly fails to break through $2,438 and falls back below $2,400, I’ll withdraw my short-term bullish view; a break below $2,354 would put me firmly on the defensive.

If I were trading this myself, I would not chase the price now. I’d only consider a small, unleveraged spot position. I would enter in two tranches, using 1.5% of my total trading capital, only if a full 4-hour candle closes above $2,438, followed by a pullback that holds $2,425–$2,438, with no clear weakening in BTC and normal exchange deposits and withdrawals. My first target would be $2,465, where I’d take half off; I’d hold the rest for $2,490 and then exit. I’d set a hard stop at $2,408, and would also exit proactively if a 4-hour candle closes back below $2,420 after entry. If ETH breaks below $2,400 before entry, I’ll cancel the plan and won’t add to the position while the price is falling. I’ll also pause if the Foundation updates the test schedule or the EIP’s status takes a negative turn. A plan that hasn’t been triggered is not a completed trade or a profit.

Sources: Ethereum Foundation’s October 16 Hoodi announcement and the EIP-7997 text; price from a Kraken snapshot. #ETH

This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

‎Здавалося б, саме з цієї різниці й потрібно сплачувати податок. Проте в Україні у 2026 році виникає принципове питання: чи можна зменшити оподатковуваний дохід від продажу криптовалюти на документально підтверджені витрати на її придбання?
‎Позиція Державної податкової служби створює серйозну невизначеність. У роз'ясненні від 6 жовтня 2026 року ДПС зазначила, що оподаткуванню підлягає сума коштів, отримана фізичною особою від операцій із криптовалютою. Отже, питання не обмежується ставкою податку: воно стосується самої бази оподаткування.
‎Це важливо для кожного, хто інвестує в біткоїн, торгує альткоїнами, використовує стейблкоїни або виводить кошти з криптобіржі на банківський рахунок.
‎FACT — 23% податків і відсутність спеціального режиму
‎Станом на жовтень 2026 року спеціальний податковий режим для операцій із віртуальними активами ще не запрацював.
‎Закон України «Про віртуальні активи», ухвалений у 2022 році, не створив повноцінного діючого режиму оподаткування криптооперацій. Для практичного запуску відповідного регулювання необхідні зміни до податкового законодавства.
‎Поки що ДПС орієнтує фізичних осіб на загальні положення Податкового кодексу.
‎Для доходів, до яких застосовуються відповідні загальні ставки, податкове навантаження становить:
‎▪️ 18% — податок на доходи фізичних осіб (ПДФО).
‎▪️ 5% — військовий збір.
‎Разом — 23% оподатковуваної суми.
‎ДПС розрізняє доходи за джерелом виплати: надходження з іноземного джерела декларується як іноземний дохід, а виплата від фізичної особи — резидента України може належати до категорії інших доходів.
‎Водночас конкретну податкову кваліфікацію потрібно визначати з урахуванням обставин операції, її сторін і документів.
‎Джерело: ДПС України, роз'яснення від 06.10.2026.
‎MECHANISM — що саме оподатковується: прибуток чи вся сума продажу?
‎У цьому питанні й полягає головна суперечність.
‎В економічному розумінні інвестиційний прибуток — це різниця між доходом від продажу активу та витратами на його придбання. Але позиція ДПС щодо криптовалют, викладена в зазначеному роз'ясненні, акцентує увагу на сумі коштів, отриманій від операції.
‎Розглянемо два можливі підходи на умовному прикладі.
‎Вихідні дані:
· ‎Витрати на придбання криптовалюти — 90 000 грн.
· ‎Сума продажу — 100 000 грн.
· ‎Прибуток до комісій — 10 000 грн.
‎Сценарій А — оподаткування всієї суми продажу.
‎100 000 × 23% = 23 000 грн.
‎У такому разі податкове навантаження перевищує прибуток у 2,3 раза.
‎Сценарій Б — оподаткування підтвердженого прибутку.
‎10 000 × 23% = 2 300 грн.
‎Різниця між двома розрахунками становить 20 700 грн.
‎Це ілюстрація податкової проблеми, а не остаточний висновок щодо обов'язкового розміру податку в кожній конкретній ситуації.
‎Важливо також не перебільшувати правову невизначеність: стаття 170.2 Податкового кодексу передбачає правила визначення інвестиційного прибутку для встановлених законом категорій активів. Спірне питання полягає в застосуванні цих положень до криптовалют за відсутності спеціального податкового режиму.
‎Саме тому формула «23% з усього обороту» описує ризик, пов'язаний із позицією податкового органу, але не повинна автоматично подаватися як остаточно встановлена законом універсальна формула для будь-якої криптооперації.
‎RISK — коли податкове навантаження може перевищити прибуток
‎Невизначеність особливо відчутна в кількох ситуаціях.
1. ‎Продаж із невеликим прибутком.
‎Інвестор вклав 90 000 грн, а продав актив за 95 000 грн. Його прибуток до комісій становить лише 5 000 грн. Якщо застосувати розрахунок із повної суми продажу, 23% становитимуть 21 850 грн.
1. ‎Продаж зі збитком.
‎Актив придбали за 100 000 грн, але через падіння ринку продали за 80 000 грн. Економічний результат — мінус 20 000 грн. За підходу, що передбачає оподаткування всієї суми надходження, розрахунок дав би 18 400 грн податків і зборів. Чи буде саме така сума належною до сплати, залежить від юридичної кваліфікації операції та застосовних норм.
1. ‎Регулярні операції та великий оборот.
‎Трейдер може багаторазово купувати й продавати активи, а значна частина надходжень буде пов'язана з поверненням раніше вкладеного капіталу. Тому оборот не можна ототожнювати з прибутком.
1. ‎Відсутність документів.
‎Якщо немає історії придбання, банківських підтверджень і звітів біржі, довести походження коштів та економічний результат стає складніше.
‎Практичний висновок: облік криптоактивів потрібен не лише для розуміння прибутковості портфеля. Він також допомагає обґрунтувати позицію платника податків у разі запитань із боку ДПС.
‎MECHANISM — законопроєкт № 10225-д: що може змінитися
‎Законодавча робота триває. Законопроєкт № 10225-д, який передбачає зміни до Податкового кодексу та інших законодавчих актів щодо обороту віртуальних активів, Верховна Рада ухвалила за основу 3 вересня 2025 року.
‎Станом на жовтень 2026 року офіційна картка парламенту вказує на підготовку документа до другого читання. Отже, запропоновані положення ще не можна вважати чинними правилами.
‎Концептуально новий режим має врегулювати правовий статус операцій із віртуальними активами та їх оподаткування. Для інвестора особливо важливими будуть такі питання:
‎▪️ Чи дозволять зменшувати дохід від продажу на документально підтверджені витрати на придбання?
‎▪️ Як визначатиметься фінансовий результат від обміну одного криптоактиву на інший?‎
‎▪️ Які правила застосовуватимуться до активів, отриманих через майнінг, стейкінг, airdrop або P2P-операції?
‎▪️ Як оподатковуватимуться збиткові операції?
‎▪️ Чи передбачатимуть перехідні положення особливий порядок для активів, придбаних до запуску нового режиму?
‎У публічному обговоренні законопроєкту фігурували різні варіанти ставок і перехідних механізмів, зокрема пільгові підходи для раніше придбаних активів. Однак конкретні умови потрібно перевіряти за актуальним текстом документа та поправками до другого читання.
‎Не можна вважати, що запропонована пільга вже гарантована, що її остаточна ставка визначена або що майбутній закон автоматично звільнить від відповідальності за попередні операції.
‎Джерело: "офіційна картка законопроєкту № 10225-д" (https://itd.rada.gov.ua/billinfo/Bills/Card/56271).
‎RISK — чи означає відсутність спеціального режиму, що криптовалюта не оподатковується?
‎Ні.
‎Відсутність окремого податкового режиму не означає автоматичного звільнення від податкових обов'язків. Якщо фізична особа отримала дохід, який відповідно до чинного законодавства підлягає декларуванню, вона повинна виконати відповідні вимоги.
‎Так само не можна стверджувати, що кожен переказ криптовалюти або кожне надходження на гаманець автоматично є оподатковуваним доходом.
‎Потрібно розрізняти:
· ‎продаж криптоактиву за фіатні кошти;
· ‎обмін одного токена на інший;
· ‎переказ між власними гаманцями;
· ‎отримання винагороди за стейкінг або майнінг;
· ‎надходження від третіх осіб;
· ‎повернення раніше вкладеного капіталу.
‎Ці операції мають різну економічну сутність, а їхні податкові наслідки залежать від обставин і застосовних правових норм.
‎Окрема ситуація — використання криптовалютних операцій у підприємницькій діяльності. ФОП не варто автоматично переносити правила особистого інвестування на свою господарську діяльність. Допустимість конкретної моделі на спрощеній системі та порядок оподаткування потрібно оцінювати окремо.
‎DECISION — що робити власнику криптоактивів у 2026 році
‎Поки законодавство змінюється, найкращий практичний підхід — не чекати остаточного ухвалення закону, а впорядкувати документи вже зараз.
‎Крок 1. Відновіть історію операцій.
‎Збережіть виписки з бірж, історію купівель і продажів, підтвердження банківських переказів, адреси власних гаманців і дані про комісії.
‎Крок 2. Відокремте власні перекази від доходів.
‎Переказ між двома власними гаманцями не тотожний продажу. Зберігайте дані, які допоможуть підтвердити, що обидві адреси належать вам.
‎Крок 3. Розрахуйте фактичний фінансовий результат.
‎Для кожної операції визначте суму придбання, суму продажу, комісії та прибуток або збиток. Окремо фіксуйте обмінні операції, стейкінг, майнінг та інші джерела надходжень.
‎Крок 4. Перевірте порядок декларування.
‎Для фізичних осіб, які зобов'язані подавати річну декларацію, загальні строки передбачають її подання до 1 травня наступного року та сплату визначених зобов'язань до 1 серпня, якщо для конкретної ситуації не встановлено інші правила. Необхідність декларування та порядок заповнення форми слід перевіряти відповідно до чинних вимог.
‎Крок 5. За значних сум отримайте індивідуальну податкову консультацію.
‎У запиті варто чітко описати спосіб придбання активу, історію операцій, джерело виплати, документи про витрати та обставини продажу. Загальне роз'яснення ДПС не завжди дає відповідь на всі питання конкретного платника.
‎Крок 6. Слідкуйте за проходженням законопроєкту № 10225-д.
‎Важливо перевіряти не лише повідомлення про його ухвалення, а й остаточний текст, дату набрання чинності, перехідні положення та правила обліку витрат.
‎ВИСНОВОК DVA — між фактичним прибутком і податковою базою
‎Оподаткування криптовалюти в Україні у 2026 році — це не лише питання ставки 18% ПДФО та 5% військового збору. Ключова проблема полягає у визначенні суми, з якої ці платежі мають розраховуватися.
‎Якщо оподатковується вся сума надходження без належного врахування вкладеного капіталу, податкове навантаження може перевищити фактичний прибуток. Водночас остаточну правову позицію не можна будувати лише на одному роз'ясненні ДПС: необхідно враховувати Податковий кодекс, характер операції та документи платника.
‎Законопроєкт № 10225-д може змінити правила гри, але до набрання відповідними нормами чинності його положення залишаються пропозиціями, а не гарантованими правами чи пільгами.
‎Для інвестора рішення просте за принципом, хоча не завжди просте на практиці: документувати операції, розрізняти оборот і прибуток, перевіряти правові підстави та не плутати очікувані зміни із чинним законодавством.
‎Справедливе оподаткування має бути зрозумілим, передбачуваним і здатним відрізняти повернення вкладеного капіталу від реально отриманого доходу.
‎DVA — факти без хайпу.
‎Не фінансова та не індивідуальна податкова порада. Матеріал має інформаційно-аналітичний характер.
‎Збереження цінностей та часу.
‎#DVA  #cryptotax  #Україна #Криптовалюта #Податки #bitcoin #usdt‏ 
#ETH

El Salvador’s Bitcoin reserves rise to 7,798, nearing the 7,800 mark

El Salvador was the first country in the world to make Bitcoin legal tender. After the Bitcoin Law took effect in September 2021, the government began steadily purchasing Bitcoin. In March 2024, officials announced that a large portion of the country’s holdings had been transferred to cold wallets in domestic physical custody vaults. The National Bitcoin Office subsequently made a holdings-tracking website and wallet addresses public, and spread the reserves across multiple addresses to strengthen security. For more than four years, this Central American nation’s Bitcoin accumulation has been a persistent topic in crypto markets.

According to the National Bitcoin Office (in an update dated October 8, 2026), El Salvador added 7 Bitcoin over the past seven days, bringing its national reserves to 7,798. At prices prevailing when the update was published, the holdings were worth more than $643 million, just short of the 7,800 mark. Its “one Bitcoin a day” accumulation strategy remains in effect. The same update included two key details: first, the International Monetary Fund recently said that El Salvador did not meet the relevant standards for public-sector holdings of crypto assets, but approved a waiver based on corrective measures and new commitments; second, IMF First Deputy Managing Director Dan Katz said that, apart from documented donations, the country was not expected to continue accumulating Bitcoin. The recent additions were reportedly funded by private donors whose identities have not been disclosed.

Looking at the longer timeline, the tension between continued accumulation and the IMF is key to understanding the story. In February 2025, the IMF Executive Board approved a 40-month Extended Fund Facility worth about $1.4 billion. Conditions included making it voluntary for businesses to accept Bitcoin, gradually winding down direct public-sector involvement in the Chivo wallet, and continuing to reduce financial risks related to Bitcoin. The agreement originally called for direct purchases to be phased out, but donations have allowed holdings to keep climbing: official figures put the total at around 6,319 in September 2025, rising to 7,798 a year later. This explains an apparent contradiction: while the country nominally continues to “add one Bitcoin a day,” its funding increasingly depends on external donations rather than direct government purchases. There is no public information about the donors’ identities or motives, so any further interpretation would be speculative.

For crypto markets, the signal sent by a sovereign nation’s continued accumulation matters more than its actual impact on supply and demand. The 7,798 Bitcoin represent a very small share of the total circulating supply, so their direct effect on market prices is limited. What the market is really absorbing is the narrative of “long-term holding at the national level,” as well as the example it offers to long-term holders during market downturns. Going forward, variables worth monitoring include whether donations continue, the limits of the IMF’s waiver mechanism, and whether more countries follow suit by establishing Bitcoin reserves.

Finally, it is important to distinguish facts from impressions: the holdings figures and the IMF’s statements are verifiable facts. The picture of domestic adoption is less positive. A 2025 study found that most residents stopped using their wallets after claiming the sign-up reward; remittances received through crypto wallets have long accounted for only around 1% to 2% of the total; and in a Central American University poll, 71.1% of respondents said Bitcoin had brought no benefits. The gap between steadily rising reserves and tepid everyday use is what makes this national experiment worth watching.

萨尔瓦多比特币储备升至7798枚，逼近7800关口

萨尔瓦多是全球首个将比特币列为法定货币的国家，2021年9月《比特币法》生效后，政府开始持续购入比特币。2024年3月官方宣布将一大笔持币转入境内实体保管库的冷钱包，国家比特币办公室随后公开持仓监控网站与地址，并把储备分散至多个地址以强化安全。四年多来，这个中美洲小国的囤币动作一直是加密市场的长期话题。

据国家比特币办公室披露（2026年10月8日消息），萨尔瓦多过去7天新增持有7枚比特币，国家储备增至7798枚，按披露时点计价超过6.43亿美元，距离7800枚关口仅一步之遥，“每日增持1枚”的策略仍在执行。同一份披露里还有两个关键细节：其一，国际货币基金组织近期表示萨尔瓦多未满足公共部门持有加密资产的相关标准，但基于纠正措施和新的承诺批准豁免；其二，IMF第一副总裁Dan Katz表示，除有记录的捐赠外，预计该国不会继续增持比特币，而近期新增持仓据称由身份未公开的私人捐赠者资助。

把时间线拉长看，增持与国际货币基金组织的博弈是理解事件的关键。2025年2月，IMF理事会核准为期40个月、规模约14亿美元的延长融资安排，条件包括商家接受比特币改为自愿、公共部门逐步淡出Chivo钱包的直接参与、并持续降低比特币相关金融风险。协议原本要求逐步停止直接购买，但捐赠通道让持仓曲线继续上行：2025年9月官方口径约为6319枚，一年后增至7798枚。这解释了一个看似矛盾的现象——名义上“每日增持1枚”，资金来源却越来越依赖外部捐赠而非财政直接购币。至于捐赠者的身份与动机，目前没有公开信息，任何进一步解读都属于推测。

对加密市场而言，主权国家持续增持的信号意义大于实际供需影响：7798枚相对比特币流通总量占比很小，对盘面的直接影响有限，真正被市场消化的是“国家层面长期持有”这一叙事，以及它在行情低迷期对长期持有者信心的参照作用。往后看，值得跟踪的变量包括捐赠是否持续、IMF豁免机制的边界，以及是否会有更多国家效仿配置比特币储备。

最后需要把事实与观感分开：持仓数字与IMF表态是可核验事实；而国内使用端并不乐观，2025年的研究显示多数居民领完钱包奖励后不再活跃，通过加密钱包入境的汇款占比长期仅约1%至2%，中美洲大学民调中71.1%的受访者认为比特币没有带来好处。储备曲线稳步上行与日常使用遇冷之间的落差，才是这场国家级实验最值得持续观察的地方。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
One term you can't avoid when trading perpetual contracts is the funding rate. It's settled every 8 hours, and it's a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay to each other. The exchange merely collects and distributes the money; it doesn't profit from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no expiry date, so how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? That's where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money changes hands between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin warning and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn't happen in an instant; it's a process. Understand that process, and you'll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing an “Insufficient margin” warning,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin threshold: When losses eat through the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of the position first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

This is where it’s easiest to get carried away: watching it swing back and forth, you keep thinking a reversal is just around the corner. I’d rather slow things down, first see how it handles the resistance above, then see whether the pullback finds genuine support. The longer you trade, the more you realize that pullbacks test not your judgment, but your patience. The signals $ETH  is giving me right now aren’t clear. They come after repeated tests, once sentiment has cooled and the price action has revealed itself. There’ll be plenty of noise along the way, so don’t mistake every bounce for a trend reversal. Patience doesn’t mean doing nothing; it means not letting short-term fluctuations lead you around.

translatedData.content:
3x Ether product gets rule approval | Fund not yet launched | ETH at $2,407: I’m waiting for confirmation

My stance is neutral to cautious: regulatory approval for a new type of product to list does not mean the market has already received three-times leveraged spot ETH buying today. Binance Square’s trending topics currently lean toward Bitcoin reserves, France’s tax bill, and divergence in U.S. stocks, with no directly relevant ETH-upside tag. So this piece focuses only on verifiable regulatory filings and avoids unrelated topics. On October 2, the U.S. SEC issued a formal order approving a rule change allowing Cboe BZX to list and trade six products under VS Trust, including a 3x Ether ETF. This is approval of a trading rule—not a guarantee of returns from the regulator, nor is the word “approved” alone enough to conclude that a particular fund has started trading and attracting inflows.

I also checked the issuer’s amended S-1 filing submitted on October 7. It explicitly states that these 3x products “have not commenced operations,” have not conducted investment activities, and have not issued shares. The filing describes the Ether product as seeking three times the daily performance of a benchmark measured using Ether futures, primarily using futures, cash, and cash equivalents rather than directly holding spot ETH. The timeline matters: approval at the rule level on October 2, while the issuer’s October 7 filing still said the product had not launched. If effective filings, listing tickers, actual trading, and holdings disclosures emerge later, the assessment should be revisited using updated information. Proposed fund size should not be treated as today’s trading volume.

The market impact mechanism is that these products could eventually add short-term risk exposure through traditional securities accounts and affect hedging and rebalancing in related futures. That is not synonymous with net inflows into a passive spot ETF. The offering documents specifically warn that the 3x target applies only to a single day. Compounding over multiple days can cause cumulative returns to diverge from “three times ETH’s return,” and in a choppy market the underlying asset could end up flat while the leveraged product loses money. My independent view is that this type of product is more likely to amplify short-term volatility and end-of-day position management than to provide a solid floor. Therefore, for spot ETH trading signals, actual fund flows, spot trading activity, and price confirmation still take priority.

How has the market reacted so far? Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,407 at the time of writing, with a daily open near $2,400 and a rolling 24-hour low of $2,354 and high of $2,438. The current price is within the range, and I see no evidence that this move can be attributed solely to the SEC order issued more than ten days ago. Around $2,438 is the current upper boundary, $2,354 is the lower boundary, and $2,400 is the short-term dividing line. If the price surges and then falls back below $2,400, the supposed product-news-driven breakout is invalidated; if it first breaks below $2,354, prioritize defense.

If I were trading this myself: I would not participate in the 3x product or use leveraged contracts. I would wait only for a bullish trigger in spot ETH. I would consider a long position using no more than 1% of total capital only after a full one-hour candle closes above $2,440 and a subsequent retest holds $2,425–$2,440. Without that trigger, I would stay out of the market. After entry, I would sell half near $2,500 and close the rest around $2,560. If a one-hour candle closes back below $2,395, I would first cut the position in half; below $2,350, I would stop out and close the entire position immediately. If the price breaks below $2,354 before entry, I would cancel the long plan. Even if the product is eventually listed, I would revise my view only based on its disclosed size and net flows, not treat its designed leverage as certain demand.

Sources: SEC Order 34-106577; VS Trust amended S-1 filing dated October 7; live Kraken ETH/USD market data.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
3倍以太坊产品获规则批准｜基金尚未开跑｜ETH在2407我守确认

我的态度是中性偏谨慎：监管允许一类新产品上市，不等于市场今天已经收到三倍的ETH现货买盘。币安广场当下热榜仍偏向比特币储备、法国税案和美股分化，没有直接对应的ETH上升标签，所以这篇只谈可以核验的监管文件，不借不相关话题。美国SEC十月二日的正式命令批准Cboe BZX为VS Trust旗下包括3x Ether ETF在内的六只产品上市交易的规则变更。这是交易规则的审批，不是监管机构保证收益，也不能仅凭“批准”两个字推断某只基金已经开盘吸金。

我再核十月七日发行人提交的S-1修订文件，里面明确写这些3倍系列“尚未开始运营”，未开展投资活动，也未发行份额；文件对Ether产品的描述是追求以以太期货基准衡量的单日三倍表现，主要使用期货、现金和现金等价物，而非直接持有实物ETH。这个时间顺序很重要：十月二日规则层面获准，十月七日发行人申报仍未开跑；若以后有生效文件、挂牌代码、实际交易及持仓披露，应以更新资料重新判断，不能把拟议规模当作今天的成交量。

影响市场的机制在于未来可能增加传统证券账户的短线风险敞口，并影响相关期货的对冲与再平衡；它不是被动现货ETF净申购的同义词。发行文件特别提醒三倍目标只针对单日，连续多日的复利路径会使累计收益偏离“ETH涨跌幅乘三”，震荡市甚至可能出现标的最终持平而杠杆产品亏损。我的独立判断是：这种产品更可能放大短线波动和盘尾仓位管理，而不是提供稳固底部。因此对现货ETH的交易信号，优先级仍低于真实的基金资金流、现货成交和价格确认。

市场已经如何反应？Kraken ETH/USD写稿约2407美元，日开约2400，滚动24小时低2354、高2438；现价位于区间内部，没有看到能够把这段波动单独归因于十多天前SEC命令的证据。2438附近是眼下的上沿，2354是下沿，2400则是短线分界。若上冲后再次跌回2400，所谓产品利好推动的突破就被推翻；若先跌破2354，防守优先。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与3倍产品，不用合约加杠杆，只等待ETH现货的多头触发。完整一小时收在2440美元上方、随后回踩2425至2440守住，才用总资金最多1%试多；未触发保持空仓。成交后2500附近减半，余仓在2560附近平仓；若一小时收回2395下方先减半，跌破2350立即止损清仓。入场前若先破2354，取消多单计划。即使后续产品真的挂牌，我也只按实披露的规模和净流量修订观点，不把设计杠杆当成确定需求。

来源：SEC命令34-106577；VS Trust十月七日S-1修订文件；Kraken ETH/USD即时行情。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you’ll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners pick one without thinking and end up paying a steep price.

【Cross margin】Your entire account balance is used as margin. The advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you’re less likely to get liquidated;
The downside: in extreme market conditions, losses could wipe out your entire account. It’s like putting all your eggs in one
propping each other up in the same basket.

【Isolated margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won’t spread to other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

🔍 BTC hashrate peaked, but there was no crash? This time, demand has changed

📊 Key Data
1. Bitcoin hashrate peaked and fell 12% over the past 3 months, but miners’ spending increased by 18% instead of falling
2. The Fear & Greed Index is neutral at 53, but Bitcoin options’ buy-to-sell volume ratio reached 1.8:1 (far above historical levels)
3. Mining pool concentration rose to 70% (a historical high), but whale address holdings fell by 25%
4. The Fed paused rate hikes in October, but implied volatility for CME Bitcoin futures remained elevated at 30%
5. Global Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed this week, but the spot premium widened to 23% (the highest since April)

📝 Analysis
▶️ A hashrate peak doesn’t mean a crash, but this time the pattern is different
Traditionally, a hashrate peak signals a wave of miner capitulation near the end of a bull market. But this time, miners are using cash to accumulate coins instead of cutting production. According to Blockchain.com data from October 15, Bitcoin held by global miners now accounts for 28% of the total market value (a record high). If hashrate keeps falling while Bitcoin’s price rises rather than falls, this thesis is invalidated. Put simply, miners aren’t short on cash and care more about the coin price than profitability.

Slowing ETF inflows should normally be bearish for Bitcoin, but a widening spot premium points to stronger demand. This contradiction suggests the market is betting on dovish signals from the Fed. If the Fed Chair’s remarks next week fall short of expectations, this thesis will unravel.

If $BTC can hold above $63,000 by October 28, the post-peak hashrate correction is just short-term consolidation, and the bullish case remains unchanged. title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1,000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are just getting started ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Let me explain it in plain English.

[The basics] Leverage is when the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U of your own capital and use 10x leverage, you actually con
trol a 1,000U position. If the coin price rises 1%, your principal gains 10% (relative to your principal); conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note, the loss is calculated based on your total leveraged position.

[The cost] With 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by around 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of around 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact level also depends on the margin ratio).

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All In—Will You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% on a win and losing 50% on a loss. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all in every time, let’s calculate the long-term result: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
That looks like positive expectancy. But consider the path: two losses in a row means a 75% loss, and you’d need a 300% gain just to break even.
A positive-expectation strategy + going all in = a high probability of ruin. This is the gambler’s ruin theorem
playing out every day in crypto.

Take the same strategy, but risk only 20% of your bankroll each time: two losses in a row = -18%, hardly a blow,
while you still capture the long-term expected gains. The strategy hasn’t changed; only your position size has, and that makes all the difference between survival and ruin.

EIP-8141 revises its fee explanation again | Paying less doesn’t mean blocks have more room | ETH near $2,408—I’m waiting

My stance is to watch cautiously, not to treat an update to protocol text that is still under review as an immediate bullish signal for ETH. On October 17, a new PR, #12537, was opened in Ethereum’s official EIPs repository. It explains how gas refunds relate to block limits in the native account abstraction proposal, EIP-8141. In the example provided by the submitter, after a refund, the payer is charged 52,000 in execution gas, plus 72,000 in state gas. But the block is still charged against the relevant limits based on 70,000 in execution gas before the refund plus 20,000 in state gas, for a total of 90,000. The PR explicitly says it only clarifies the wording; the existing formula is unchanged. It is still Open and awaiting review by the author. The official EIP page is also still marked Draft. So “users pay a little less” does not mean “the block magically has that same amount of extra capacity,” much less that mainnet fees are lower today.

This matters to the crypto market, but the effects would take time to feed through. If account abstraction is approved and deployed in the future, wallets could arrange verification, batch operations, and fee payments more flexibly. Clearer fee boundaries could also help wallets, paymaster services, and block builders calculate risk. But growth in demand, increased ETH burns, and improved staking yields would all need to be validated through actual usage and final parameters. A proposal merely being under review neither proves that users will switch immediately nor means future UX improvements can be directly translated into spot buying. In particular, risk assets are currently being buffeted by volatility in U.S. tech stocks, so the technical roadmap and short-term liquidity should be assessed separately.

As for the market reaction, at the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,408, with a daily open near $2,399.83 and a rolling 24-hour range of $2,354.01 to $2,438. The current price is in the upper half of the range, but still facing resistance near the top. This price move cannot be attributed to last night’s wording PR. I’ll first watch to see whether $2,438 is decisively broken, then whether $2,354 holds. If the price only jumps on the headline and then falls back into the range, that would be one signal that my assessment was wrong. ETFs don’t have a regular trading day over the weekend, so old daily flow data should not be presented as fresh institutional inflows.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now, keep a neutral directional bias, and hold a 0% position. Only if ETH closes above $2,438 on the one-hour chart, holds that level on a retest, and BTC does not weaken at the same time would I consider a small spot long using at most 0.5% of my total capital. I’d initially target $2,470 and take half off there, with the rest aimed at $2,500; I’d exit if momentum faded. After entering, if the one-hour candle closes back below $2,438 or the price drops below $2,400, I’d stop out in full. If $2,354 breaks first, I’d cancel the long plan and would not add to a position against the trend. I won’t use high leverage to bet on a draft becoming news, and I won’t count a plan that hasn’t triggered as a trade.

Sources: Official Ethereum EIP-8141 page; ethereum/EIPs PR #12537. Price is a Kraken ETH/USD snapshot at the time of writing. #ETH

This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把一份尚在审阅的协议文字更新当成ETH的即刻利好。以太坊EIPs官方仓库10月17日新开PR #12537，针对原生账户抽象草案EIP-8141解释Gas退款与区块上限的关系。提交者给出的例子里，执行Gas经退款后向付款人收取5.2万，加上状态Gas为7.2万；但区块仍按退款前的7万执行Gas加2万状态Gas、合计9万计入对应上限。PR明确只是修正文案，已有公式不变，且目前仍Open、等待作者审阅。官方EIP页面也仍标注Draft。因此“用户少付了一些”不等于“区块凭空多出相同容量”，更不等于主网今天降费。

Many assume the low price is a discount. This is a thought experiment, not a fact about your account. If you bought earlier, you may still hold. If you missed it, you might buy later out of fear. Neither action is wrong. The danger is changing your risk plan because of an emotional anchor.

How It Changes Decisions

Loss aversion can distort volume analysis. When 5.13592 sits above baseline while price falls, some traders panic. They see 5.58101 and imagine large swings. They might tighten stops too quickly. Others wait for a bounce that may not come. This hesitation can lead to buying at 2430 instead of 2405.2. The key is recognizing that volume confirms activity, not direction. A drop in -0.0600942 needs context from daily trends. If 2413.74 is below 2413.22, the structural view is bearish. But daily holds might show different signals. Do not let one hourly candle define your entire thesis.

Practical Self-Check

Ask yourself: Would I enter this position if I had never seen it? If the answer changes based on your cost basis, you are anchored. Reset your view. Ignore the price you paid. Focus on current data. Check if 47.5943 and 0.794895 align with the move. If they contradict the price action, be cautious. Decide your exit rules before entry. This prevents regret-driven trading. Your plan should stand on logic, not past mistakes. Keep your focus on the present market structure.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | The Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Play from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script for every market cycle is almost the same:
① Doubt phase: Prices rise for a few days, but no one believes it. Everyone is saying, “Sell the bounce.”
② Acceptance phase: Prices hit new highs, analysts start turning bullish, and retail investors climb aboard with mixed feelings.
③ Excitement phase: Prices keep surging, people in the group start posting their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria phase: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is soaring.
⑤ Denial phase: Prices start falling, and everyone says, “It’s a healthy pullback—a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic phase: Prices plunge day after day, and everyone is rushing to cut their losses—yet this is where the seeds of the next cycle are sown.

$UNI  The most frustrating thing about it right now is that it just won't move. It can really wear people down and make them give up! 🦄
Lately, whenever I open UNI's chart, it just keeps hovering around the $7 range.
Want to wait for a big dip before adding more? It drops, then bounces back a little.
Want to wait for a big rally? You can watch it half the day and still see nothing happening.
A lot of people may have already gotten tired of watching it, thinking this coin is so dull and they might as well chase other hot trends.

But I actually think the most worthwhile thing to watch right now is which direction it chooses next.
That earlier drop from around $9 has already cooled market sentiment quite a bit.
Now, $UNI  isn't plunging every day or taking off in a straight line. It's just grinding sideways near the lows.
The thing about a sideways market is that it can slowly wear down even the most confident people until they have no patience left.
Just when you decide it's going nowhere, remove it from your watchlist, and go chase another coin, one day trading volume suddenly surges and the price climbs steadily—and you can't help but come back to take another look.

At that point, your mindset is completely different.
I'm watching UNI now not because I have to guess which day it will rally, but because I want to see when this consolidation at these levels starts to change.
If buyers return and the price breaks out on rising volume, then this period of sideways trading will be worth reassessing.
Once the trend really takes shape and the community starts buzzing again, a lot of people may start wondering whether it's still worth chasing.

The assets people are most likely to overlook are precisely the ones that have been moving sideways so long that nobody wants to talk about them anymore.
Of course, it could keep trading sideways too; no one can know in advance when it will move.
But I don't want to wait until $UNI  really takes off before starting my research from scratch.
It's a little over $7 now, so I'll keep watching for a chance to add more. Market trends change every day, but your own watchlist shouldn't change with your mood every day.
If you wait until it starts moving to ask, “Why didn't anyone warn me earlier?” it'll be a bit too late. 🔥

OTC sentiment returns to neutral | ETH reclaims 2400 but flows haven’t turned | I’m waiting for confirmation, not chasing the rally

My stance is to hold off on chasing longs for now. Binance Square’s trending topic still shows #ETHDropsBelow2400USDT, referring to the earlier drop below $2,400—not saying ETH is still below that level as I write. Binance OTC and Execution Services’ weekly report for October 15 lowered its assessment of market sentiment from greed to neutral. It noted that ETF demand had shifted from clearly positive net inflows to near stagnation, with a slight tilt toward outflows, while on-chain DEX trading had also cooled. These are the desk’s observations for the week through October 15, not newly reported real-time orders today—and its views should not be mistaken for an announcement from the Ethereum Foundation. It’s a reminder to me that a price rebound can be driven by short covering, but for it to become a sustainable move, fresh spot demand still needs to take over.

For ETH specifically, Farside’s fund-by-fund table shows that U.S. spot Ethereum funds recorded combined net outflows of $60.3 million on October 15 and a further $69.7 million on October 16, for a total of about $130 million over the two days. Most of the latter day’s outflows were attributed to ETHA; the other funds showed zero or amounts rounded to zero. Funds don’t trade over the weekend, so these figures should not be treated as real-time Sunday flows, nor directly equated with spot selling on exchanges at the same moment. What’s really worth watching is the next U.S. trading day: will outflows spread across multiple products, or will net inflows return? If marginal ETF demand remains weak while crypto spot prices rise on their own, I’ll discount the credibility of this rebound.

There is still some support in the market. As I write, Kraken ETH/USD is around $2,413, with a daily open near $2,400, a rolling 24-hour low of $2,354, and a high of $2,438. The price has rebounded from the low, but has yet to break above the top of this range. $2,400 is a psychological and price-test level; around $2,395 is the nearer intraday line of defense, while $2,438 is the resistance overhead that needs to be cleared. I’ll become more bullish only if ETH breaks above $2,438, holds on a subsequent retest, and the next fund data stops deteriorating. If it falls back below $2,395 and cannot reclaim $2,400 on a rebound, the current “recovery in progress” assumption is invalidated. If BTC weakens at the same time, I’ll cut risk more quickly. These are conditional assessments; I’m not claiming that the OTC report or fund figures alone caused the current price movement.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now. I’d only consider a small long position, capped at 3% of total capital, with no high leverage. The entry trigger would be ETH moving above $2,440, then holding around $2,430 on a pullback and strengthening again. The first target is $2,480, where I’d take half off; the second is $2,520, with protection on the remaining position moved up as the price develops. I’d place the initial stop at $2,392. If ETH falls back below $2,420 after entry and the rebound is weak, I’d exit early rather than wait for the fixed stop. If the price first drops below $2,395, I’d cancel the long plan and avoid averaging down against the trend. If multiple funds continue to post net outflows on the next fund trading day and the price still hasn’t cleared $2,438, I’d remain out of the market. These price levels are execution conditions; they don’t mean I’ve already entered a trade or made a profit.

#ETHDropsBelow2400USDT #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

OTC情绪退回中性｜ETH收复2400但资金未转向｜我只等确认不追涨

我的态度是暂不追多。币安广场热榜仍显示#ETHDropsBelow2400USDT，描述的是此前跌破2400美元，并非写稿此刻仍在该价下方。币安OTC与执行服务10月15日的周报把市场情绪由贪婪降到中性，提到ETF需求从之前的明显净流入转为接近停滞、略偏流出，链上DEX成交也降温。这是交易台对截至10月15日一周的观察，不是今天新增的实时订单，更不能把其观点当作以太坊基金会公告。它给我一个提醒：价格反抽可以由空头回补形成，但要变成可持续行情，仍须看到新的现货需求接棒。

具体到ETH，Farside逐只基金表显示，美国现货以太坊基金10月15日合计净流出6030万美元，10月16日又净流出6970万美元，两日合计约1.30亿美元。后一天主要列在ETHA；其他基金显示零或四舍五入后的零。周末基金不开盘，这组数字不能当作周日实时资金流，也不能直接等同于同一时刻交易所现货抛压。真正值得观察的是下一个美股交易日，流出是否扩散到多只产品，还是出现反向净申购。如果ETF边际需求继续弱，而加密现货独自上涨，我会把这轮反弹的可信度打折。

市场并非没有承接。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2413美元，日开约2400，滚动24小时低点2354、高点2438；低点到现价已有反弹，但尚未越过这段区间上沿。2400是心理与价格检验线，2395附近是日内更近的防线，2438是上方需要突破的压力。只有突破2438后回踩仍守住，同时下一次基金数据不再恶化，我才提高偏多判断。若重新跌破2395且反抽无法站回2400，当前“修复中”的假设就被推翻；若BTC同步转弱，我会更快缩小风险。以上只是条件判断，不声称OTC报告或基金数字单独造成了眼前价格变化。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只准备轻仓做多，总资金上限3%，不用高杠杆。入场触发是ETH站上2440，随后回踩2430附近不破并再次转强；第一目标2480，到位减半，第二目标2520，余仓随走势上移保护。初始止损放在2392；若入场后收回2420下方且反抽无力，提前平仓，不等固定止损。若价格先跌破2395，取消多单计划，不逆势补仓。若下个基金交易日多只产品继续净流出且价格仍未越2438，也保持空仓。这些价位是执行条件，不代表我已经成交或获利。

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

#ETH #Gas #BTC

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What’s the Fuel Cost of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay Gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, running
a contract) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain transactions late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

以太坊市场深度分析：区间震荡格局延续，关注机构动向变化

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月十八日中午十二点，以太坊报价二千四百一十八点九三美元，过去二十四小时几乎持平，微跌零点零二个百分点。从小时级别走势来看，价格在二千四百零五美元至二千四百三十美元区间内波动，整体呈现温和反弹后回落整理的态势。

早盘阶段，以太坊从二千四百零五美元附近起步，在逢低买盘的推动下逐步攀升至二千四百三十美元，随后遭遇卖压回落。午盘时段价格回踩至二千四百一十五美元附近，最终在二千四百一十六美元一线企稳。值得注意的是，此前以太坊曾短暂下探至二千三百八十美元，在该位置出现了超过一亿八千万美元的大量成交，显示有资金在关键支撑位积极承接。

从日线级别观察，以太坊目前运行在九十九周期指数移动均线二千四百三十八美元下方，该位置构成了短期的关键阻力。同时，二十五周期均线二千四百一十九美元与当前价格几乎重合，表明短期均线正在形成压制。价格需要有效突破二千四百四十美元才能打开进一步上涨空间。

二、技术指标解读

从动量指标来看，相对强弱指数六周期报五十三点二三，十二周期报四十九点七九，二十四周期报四十八点零九，整体处于中性区域，多空力量相对均衡。随机相对强弱指标从此前的高位回落至八十七附近，显示短期上涨动能有所减弱。

移动平均线系统呈现空头排列特征。七周期均线报二千四百一十三美元，位于二十五周期均线二千四百一十九美元下方，而二十五周期均线又低于九十九周期均线二千四百三十美元。这种短中长期均线依次抬高的格局表明，以太坊仍处于中期调整趋势中。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于二千四百四十二美元，中轨二千四百一十五美元，下轨二千三百八十八美元，带宽约五十四美元。价格目前运行在中轨与上轨之间，略偏强势但空间有限。

综合指标方面，MACD柱状图连续三期为正值且持续扩大，最新报一点七一，显示短期多头动能正在积累。MACD线从负七点四三收窄至负三点四二，正在向零轴靠拢。但综合信号模型给出看空判断，十五个因子中六个看多、八个看空、一个中性，空方略占优势。

三、市场情绪分析

当前以太坊市场情绪偏谨慎。现货ETF在十月十二日至十六日期间累计净流出超过三亿二千万美元，反映出机构投资者在宏观不确定性下的减仓意愿。持续的ETF赎回对价格形成压制，限制了反弹空间。

不过，基本面支撑因素同样值得关注。德意志银行计划推出加密资产托管服务，首批支持比特币和以太坊，基于Taurus技术开发，面向德国机构客户。嘉信理财也向散户开放了以太坊交易功能，传统金融的持续入局为以太坊提供了中长期需求支撑。

从技术面看，以太坊在二千三百八十美元位置获得了强力支撑，大量资金在此位置积极买入，显示市场对该价位的认可度较高。这种逢低买入的行为为价格提供了一定的底部保护。

链上数据方面，OBV指标显示近期卖压有所缓解，从负七十六万九千收窄至负七十六万二千。虽然整体仍处于流出状态，但流出速度明显放缓，暗示抛压正在逐步减弱。

从波动率指标观察，十四周期ATR从十四点八四降至十三点五一，显示价格波动率正在收窄。结合布林带带宽的收窄，这种低波动状态通常预示着大幅行情即将到来。

综合来看，以太坊短期处于区间震荡格局，上方二千四百四十美元阻力与下方二千三百八十美元支撑形成对峙。ETF持续流出是主要压力来源，但传统金融机构的入场和关键支撑位的强力承接为价格提供了底部保护。建议投资者关注ETF资金流向变化以及宏观经济数据，在区间内高抛低吸，等待方向明确后再加大仓位。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

dollars (and equivalent assets) in reserve. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can ask the issuer
